summary: Market tone is mixed-to-bullish for crypto, with Bitcoin and gold both supported by macro-driven momentum, while equities appear more selective and vulnerable to AI/semiconductor concerns. Altcoin opportunity signals are concentrated rather than broad, with Hyperliquid-style revenue and flow names favored and several small-cap narratives still attracting attention.
